issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement labels the class as 'Course' while the rest of the exercise (text, template code, and solution) refers to the class as 'Lecture'. This naming mismatch within the specification can confuse students about which class they should implement and refer to.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the class name consistent across all artifacts. Update the UML diagram in problem_statement.md to use 'Lecture' (instead of 'Course'), or alternatively rename the template and solution classes to 'Course' if that was the intended name. Ensure the UML and textual references match the class name used in the provided code templates.
